# Literature review

This replay fixture runs without a literature search (no references are added to the study). The draft therefore cites no work, and the citation check reports that the study has no references.

The method follows the difference-in-differences literature on staggered adoption: a two-way fixed-effects regression averages comparisons that can carry negative weights when effects vary, so the study uses the group-time estimator of Callaway and Sant'Anna and reports effects by event time with a pre-trends test and a sensitivity analysis.
